concept: fable · 11 Sheaf — Rethemed Tabbed Organizer (grouped category tabs over layered sheets)

plan_owner_impacts.evidence: Grouped-tab navigation: 9 top-level tabs over the 12 canonical categories with an in-sheet category lens for the three shared tabs (Memory & Planning, Collaboration, Media & Web). The spec must state that a Home reorganization may group categories only with a complete documented mapping and per-category routes preserved (#/dest/<cat> stays canonical; the lens is presentation, not scope).

Sheet-pile location model: deeper navigation lays a sheet inside the same tabbed frame; the crumb-chip pile (Home > Category > Manager > Object) is the location instrument at every width, and stacked-edge affordances on the sheet communicate depth without route replacement beyond the canonical grammar.

system.health.diagnostics-verbosity exists only in the legacy rev-2 demo dataset, not in the 828-row v2 inventory. This concept treats it honestly: the deep link renders a non-crashing 'not in this project's settings' surface with search/All-Settings escapes, while the real row system.health.platform-diagnostics lands exactly. The inventory census should retire or re-mint the stale probe id.
Permissions manager rendered from the shared view model (rules, presets, FileSafe floor checks) in Sheaf's line/roster grammar; no new permission semantics were invented.

Provider detail tabs (Overview / Accounts / Models / Usage & limits / Routing / Installations / Setup / Activity / Advanced) render multi-install selected/shadowed flags, unknown-owner manual-only refusal, ask-first update actions, and verification-failed-then-rolled-back history as first-class tab content inside the same sheet pile — the plan should adopt the tabbed detail composition as one sanctioned provider layout.
Server-connection providers surface the server tab (address, version, reachability, catalog source, scoped token reference) verbatim from shared resolvers.
Accounts tab renders auth-boundary ownership, priority, sticky/use-next, and health words from PMProvider resolvers without re-deriving state.

Tab and sheet navigation implies a cmd.settings.navigate {dest} family plus a cmd.settings.sheet.pop (one level out) command; the Escape ladder (popup > drawer > one level > stop at Home) needs a canonical keybinding statement. See candidate-command-delta.json — all provisional.
Memory manager consumed as shared view model in concept grammar; no memory semantics changed.

Ten keystone traces registered in candidate-wiring-delta.json, every one flagged concept_local_state — copy transaction, search landing, tab navigation, advanced disclosure, provider tab selection, installation ask-first update, rollback, facet filtering, escape ladder, category lens.

boundary_confirmations: Project-only: no scope selectors anywhere; the frame bar states 'changes apply to this project only'; legacyScope appears only inside the row Details drawer as history.
Copy is a one-time transaction: restore point > atomic apply > verify > receipt > working rollback; no sync or link language anywhere in the flow.

Provider CLIs: the Cursor CLI setup tab is explicit, user-triggered, official-source (cursor.com/cli), exact host/environment radio choice, sign-in a separate step; the unknown-owner Ollama installation exposes no update action and returns an honest refusal.
ObservableWork: the ops strip renders determinate progress only when the op payload carries a real denominator; otherwise indeterminate with phase text; terminal states shown truthfully.
ResourceGovernor: no second governor — op strips are projections of PM2.states.op events only.
